# KiCad AutoRouter Documentation

This book contains two reference documents:

1. **[Physics Primer](physics_primer.html)** — Force laws, parameter tradeoffs, and SVG render guide for the SI placement dynamics engine.
2. **[Pytest Results](pytest_results.html)** — Test suite overview, physics validation results, and regression tracking.

## Regeneration

These documents are generated from executable Quarto markdown (`.qmd`). To regenerate:

```bash
# Physics Primer (runs embedded matplotlib visualizations)
./scripts/regen_physics_primer.sh

# Static expected-behavior figures (committed PNGs, no Quarto needed)
python scripts/plot_force_laws.py --outdir docs/figures

# Pytest Results (runs test suite and embeds output)
./scripts/regen_pytest_report.sh
```

Both scripts render HTML and PDF to `docs/_output/` (gitignored).
